Delhi HC hears appeals in 2020 riots IB staffer murder case

The Delhi High Court is hearing appeals filed by two individuals convicted in the murder of an Intelligence Bureau (IB) staffer during the 2020 Delhi riots. The court has asked the Delhi Police to present their stance on these appeals. The convicts are challenging their life sentences awarded in the Ankit Sharma murder case. The proceedings are ongoing in the High Court.
